raw_comment: I noticed that the middle states of the U.S. such as Texas, Montana, and Wyoming are experiencing more extreme droughts that the east and west coast states like New York and California. I wonder if this has to do with those states not being so close to a large body of water, or due to the number of deserts located in those areas. This relates to my community and I because where I live, October was filled with no chance of rain for a while. This led to some growing concern for farmers and other people that are trying to maintain their crops and plants. I began to notice that the grass and became drier. A catchy headline would be A Drought Throughout: What US States Were Affected the Most by This Drought?
